fields.name: startCutscene

doc.text: Starts a cutscene.

params.prefix: Custom prefix. Using `midsong-` will require you to for example rename your video cutscene to `songs/song/midsong-cutscene.mp4` instead of `songs/song/cutscene.mp4`
params.callback: Callback called after the cutscene ended. If equals to `null`, `startCountdown` will be called.
params.checkSeen: Bool that by default is false, if true and `seenCutscene` is also true, it won't play the cutscene but directly call `callback` (PS: `seenCutscene` becomes true if the cutscene gets played and `checkSeen` was true)
params.canSkipTransIn: Bool that by default is true makes the in transition skip on certain types of cutscenes like dialogues.
